title: stachys recta subsp. delphinensis
intro: Stachys recta subsp. delphinensis, commonly known as the Alpine Woundwort, is a subspecies of the Stachys recta plant, which belongs to the Lamiaceae family. This perennial herb is used in traditional medicine for its antiseptic, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, providing relief from various health issues. The health benefits of Stachys recta subsp. delphinensis include wound healing, reduced inflammation, and the treatment of gastrointestinal problems. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and iridoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions such as antioxidant and antimicrobial activities.
